brief: Holds two numbers and compares them: least common multiple, greatest common divisor, speed-up factor and percentage gain.
detail: Build one with new stzPairOfNumbers([ a, b ]) or StzPairOfNumbersQ([ a, b ]); it is a stzPair, so Item1, Item2, Swap and the rest of the pair vocabulary are inherited. The measures are written for a before and an after, such as two timings: SpeedUp is a divided by b, GainFactor is b divided by a, PerfGain is the drop as a percentage of a, Gain is the rise as a percentage of b. Global functions of the same names (SpeedUp, PerfGain, GainFactor, RelativeGain, LeastCommonMuliple, GreatestCommonDividor) take the two numbers directly. BothAreBetween has a defect with a large first number.
